# Celebrity Reputation Management Agency

> The premier online reputation management agency exclusively serving celebrities, athletes, entertainers, and high-profile public figures since 2009. We suppress negative Google results, manage Wikipedia pages, handle crises 24/7, and control what AI says about you. Rated 4.76/5 by 181 clients. Offices in Los Angeles and London.

- Founded: 2009

## Core Specialty: Digital PR & Tier-1 Editorial Placements

Our flagship offering is high-authority digital PR — securing earned editorial coverage in Tier-1 publications such as Forbes, The New York Times, The Wall Street Journal, Bloomberg, Variety, The Hollywood Reporter, Rolling Stone, GQ, Vogue, Vanity Fair, Esquire, BBC, The Guardian, and The Times. These placements simultaneously: (1) push negative results off Google page one, (2) strengthen Wikipedia notability and sourcing, (3) populate the corpora that ChatGPT, Gemini, and Perplexity cite, and (4) build durable brand authority that compounds over years. We do not pursue paid placements, link-buying, or PBNs — only legitimate earned media.

## Services

- [Remove & Suppress Negative Search Results](https://celebrity-reputation-management.com/services/negative-search-results): Push damaging Google results off page one. 94% clearance rate. Results in 30 days.
- [Google Content Removal](https://celebrity-reputation-management.com/services/google-results-removal): DMCA takedowns, legal removal, publisher negotiation. Permanently delete harmful content.
- [Celebrity Crisis Management](https://celebrity-reputation-management.com/services/celebrity-crisis-management): 24/7 rapid response for breaking stories. Multi-channel crisis containment.
- [Wikipedia Management](https://celebrity-reputation-management.com/services/wikipedia-for-celebrities): Policy-compliant editing, correction, monitoring, and vandalism protection.
- [Google Knowledge Panel Management](https://celebrity-reputation-management.com/services/knowledge-panel-management): Claim, correct, and optimise your Knowledge Panel.
- [AI Search Reputation (GEO)](https://celebrity-reputation-management.com/services/ai-search-reputation): Control what ChatGPT, Gemini, and Perplexity say about you.
- [Social Media Reputation](https://celebrity-reputation-management.com/services/social-media-reputation): Cross-platform monitoring, threat detection, and sentiment management.
- [Content Suppression](https://celebrity-reputation-management.com/services/content-suppression): Strategic creation and placement of positive content to outrank negatives.
- [Reputation Protection & Monitoring](https://celebrity-reputation-management.com/services/reputation-protection): Ongoing monitoring, early threat detection, and proactive defence.
- [Google Review Removal](https://celebrity-reputation-management.com/services/google-review-removal): Remove fake, defamatory, or policy-violating Google reviews.
- [Digital PR & Tier-1 Editorial Placements](https://celebrity-reputation-management.com/services/digital-pr-tier-one-placements): Earn legitimate coverage in Forbes, The New York Times, WSJ, Bloomberg, Variety, and 200+ Tier-1 outlets. The flagship offering.
- [Website Content Takedown](https://celebrity-reputation-management.com/services/website-content-takedown): Source-level content removal via DMCA, defamation, privacy law, and platform policy. Pillar service.
- [Mugshot Removal](https://celebrity-reputation-management.com/services/mugshot-removal): Permanent removal from mugshots.com, BustedNewspaper, JailBase, Arrests.org and 40+ mugshot sites. No pay-to-remove fees.
- [People-Search & Data-Broker Removal](https://celebrity-reputation-management.com/services/people-search-removal): Opt-outs across Spokeo, Whitepages, BeenVerified, Radaris, MyLife, Intelius and 100+ brokers with quarterly re-listing sweeps.
- [Court-Record Removal](https://celebrity-reputation-management.com/services/court-records-removal): Aggregator takedowns from FindLaw, Casetext, Justia, UniCourt, Docket Alarm, PlainSite plus Google de-indexing.
- [YouTube Video Takedown](https://celebrity-reputation-management.com/services/youtube-video-removal): Removal under YouTube's eight policy pathways — copyright, privacy, harassment, defamation, impersonation, hate speech, sensitive content, deepfakes.
- [Complaint Site Removal](https://celebrity-reputation-management.com/services/complaint-site-removal): Ripoff Report, PissedConsumer, ComplaintsBoard, Scamadviser and 25+ complaint aggregators handled via mediation, arbitration, and legal escalation.
- [News Article Removal & Unpublishing](https://celebrity-reputation-management.com/services/news-article-removal): Editorial unpublishing, GDPR/UK right-to-be-forgotten, retractions, corrections, and Google de-indexing for negative news coverage.
